name: JAKS
recent: JAKS Resources 正推进最多 10% 的私募配售以偿还债务和补充营运资金，同时延长出售 JAKS Solar Nibong Tebal 的截止日期至 2027 年。公司最新季度净利同比增长 30.9%，但营收同比下滑 7.8%。
notable: 用于偿还债务和营运资金。
并结算最多 4000 万令吉欠款。
出售 JAKS Solar Nibong Tebal 的完成期限延长至 2027 年 5 月 31 日。
risks: 私募配售最多 10% 新股可能摊薄现有股东持股。
公司涉及重大诉讼（公告编号 7）。
出售 JAKS Solar Nibong Tebal 的条件尚未满足，完成日期已延长。
earnings: 2026 年第二季度营收为 1115 万令吉，环比增长 19.8%，同比下滑 7.8%；净利为 1306 万令吉，环比下降 22.9%，同比增长 30.9%，净利率为 117.1%。

recent_en: JAKS Resources is undertaking a private placement of up to 10% to repay debt and fund working capital, while extending the deadline for the disposal of JAKS Solar Nibong Tebal to 2027. Latest quarterly net profit rose 30.9% year-on-year, though revenue fell 7.8%.
notable_en: Proposed private placement of up to 10% new shares to repay debt and for working capital.
Proposed disposal of 100% equity interest in JAKS Solar Nibong Tebal for RM15 million cash and settlement of up to RM40 million owing.
Completion deadline for the disposal of JAKS Solar Nibong Tebal extended to 31 May 2027.
risks_en: Private placement of up to 10% new shares may dilute existing shareholders.
Company is involved in material litigation (announcement no. 7).
Conditions for the disposal of JAKS Solar Nibong Tebal are not yet fulfilled; completion date has been extended.
earnings_en: Q2 2026 revenue was RM11.15 million, up 19.8% QoQ but down 7.8% YoY; net profit was RM13.06 million, down 22.9% QoQ but up 30.9% YoY, with a net margin of 117.1%.
